identity.name: SerienHub Redesign
identity.description: A high-density information hub for series fans, prioritizing latest news while keeping critical metadata accessible.

components_to_implement.name: HeroSection
components_to_implement.description: Immersive backdrop with title and primary actions
components_to_implement.instructions: Use 'image_url_1' for backdrop. Overlay gradient must match page background. Title should be massive (text-5xl+).

components_to_implement.name: NewsFeed
components_to_implement.description: The main focus. List of articles with 'featured' article at top.
components_to_implement.instructions: Use masonry or mixed list layout. Featured article gets 100% width. Standard articles get side-by-side layout.

components_to_implement.name: InfoSidebar
components_to_implement.description: Sticky sidebar containing status, cast, and streaming info.
components_to_implement.instructions: Glassmorphic container. Status needs to be very visible (Green/Red pill).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: The user wants NEWS to be the main focus. Do not hide it. It should be the first thing after the hero.
Use the 'Cyan/Blue' gradient for the 'Follow' button and primary actions.
Implement the 'InfoSidebar' as a sticky element on desktop.
Ensure the design works for both German and English text (content is German).
Preserve existing functionality: SeriesStatusBox logic (fetching from API) must be kept but styled differently.
For the 'News Feed', use the 'SeriesHubArticles' component logic but completely redesign the UI.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
